label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: The cookie banner is announced first but, after declining it, keyboard focus is lost and drops to nothing, so I had to start tabbing again from the top of the page.
Before reaching the first product I tabbed through an unnamed link and a Previous/Next carousel button whose name is just an icon, which gives no hint of what they do.

After pressing Add to Cart, focus was dropped and the page said nothing about the item being added; the cart count and a cart panel only showed up when I re-read the page, so a keyboard user gets no confirmation.
The Add to Cart button chose a variant for me ([name] / Red) without asking, and the product name on the card does not say which option was added.

In the cart panel, quantity controls are links with only icon names (Decrease quantity, Increase quantity) and Remove sits right before the CHECKOUT button, so a stray Enter could remove the item; I needed 7 tabs to reach CHECKOUT.
After activating CHECKOUT the new page showed nothing at first and focus was on nothing; I had to re-read to see the form. No loading status was given.
